text_blocks.snippet: HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) is primarily transmitted through the following routes:

list.snippet: Unprotected vaginal, anal, or oral sex with an HIV-positive person
Exchange of bodily fluids during sexual activity
Sharing needles or syringes for injecting drugs
Transfusions of contaminated blood or blood products (rare in developed countries due to screening procedures)
